title: feat(formula): current_user.hasCapability(name) — a page predicate can ask whether the viewer holds a system capability
body:
Fixes #24414

Clause-②: yes (widening)

Dev session `session_01AQxxbsMRiqgkrsU3Xd54yE`, dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 1 PM (`session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`, claim 6259485251). Owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue.

## What changed

- **`packages/formula` standard library: `current_user.hasCapability(name)`**, registered beside `can`, receiver-only (a bare `hasCapability(name)` names no subject and does not resolve, exactly as a bare `can` does). It answers from the acting subject's held system capabilities: the `systemPermissions` list `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` returns, which is the list the action gate checks `requiredPermissions` against (ADR-0066 D4).
  - held: `true`; not held: `false`; empty list: `false` (a real answer).
  - no list on the context: **throws** (`ok: false`, `kind: 'runtime'`), the way `can()` does. Also throws on a non-list, a non-string or empty name, and a receiver that is not the acting subject.
  - a name no action declares is just a string. No registry lookup.
  - `can(object, verb)` with an out-of-vocabulary verb still throws; its message now also names `current_user.hasCapability('NAME')` for a capability question. No new error code.
- **The subject contract.** `EvalContext` gains `systemPermissions?: EvalSystemPermissions` (a list of names, the published field verbatim), and `PermissionBinding` gains the same field (optional, so existing constructors still compile). `celEngine.evaluate` pins it into the binding beside `permissions`. Like `permissions`, it is not mounted as a CEL variable.
- **The save door's lint.** No code change was needed: `validateVisibilityPredicates`' unknown-function arm asks formula's `firstUnknownFunctionCall`, whose oracle is the evaluation environment itself (ruling on #13594, never a name list). Registering the function admits it. Pinned on a page component `visibleWhen`, beside a control (`hasCapabilities`, still refused as `visibility-predicate-unknown-function`).
- **Docs.** The page component `visibleWhen` describe (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`) names `current_user.hasCapability('NAME')` as the way to gate a component on a capability, says it reads the list the action gate reads (never a `can(...)` proxy), says a host that binds no list makes it fault (and a faulting predicate renders the component), and keeps ADR-0066 D4: `visibleWhen` hides, `requiredPermissions` refuses. `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx` regenerated by `check:generated --fix` (only artifact it proved stale).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/24414-capability-predicate.md`: `@objectstack/formula` minor, `@objectstack/spec` patch (describe text only), carrying the `Clause-②` line.

### Where the subject contract really lives (measured, so the file surface moved)

The claim's `packages/core/src/evaluator/subjectPermissions.ts` does not exist on `origin/main` (`git ls-files | grep -i subjectPerm` = 0 hits; `packages/core/src` has no `evaluator/` directory). The evaluator subject is `EvalContext` (`packages/formula/src/types.ts`) plus `PermissionBinding` (`packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts`), so the field landed there. `@objectstack/core` is untouched, so it gets no changeset.

### Server-side binders of the subject, and which supply the list today

Every server-side binder that passes object permissions into `EvalContext` is in `@objectstack/objectql`: `engine.ts` `permissionResolution` feeds CEL `defaultValue`s, option `visibleWhen` gates and formula fields, and `validation/rule-validator.ts` feeds validation rules (`permissions:` on `evaluateValidationRules`). **None supplies `systemPermissions` today**, so `hasCapability` in a server-evaluated predicate throws loudly until a binder supplies it. The page surface's binder is objectui's (the objectui card the ruling filed), not this PR.

## Verification

All on head `d347ecd10` (after merging `origin/main` at `ec951e29e`) unless noted.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula test`: 48 files, 1344 tests passed. New file `src/capability-predicate.test.ts` pins held / not held / empty list / list absent (throws) / undeclared name is just a string / every ADR-0068 alias / off-shape list / wrong receiver / non-string name / bare call / existence oracle (with an invented-sibling control) / `validateExpression('predicate', …)` ok / the `can` message pointer.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 145 files, 6867 tests passed (the new page-predicate pin included).
- typecheck exit 0: `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, and the subject type's consumers `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`.
- Reverse verification of the cross-package type (consumer reads the rebuilt `.d.ts`): a scratch file in `packages/objectql/src` with `systemPermissions: [1]` gave `TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'`, the string form compiled; file removed, tree clean.
- Ablation (lint pin reads formula through `dist/`): the registered signature renamed to `hasCapabilityZZ` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `83bc57b0907c` to `463e76c9182b`), formula rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 2 built files, lint pin **red** (1 failed / 195). Restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, preflight `--absent` over 6 built files, pin green (196 passed).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived **112** commands on `d347ecd10`; every line run, exit captured before any pipe; **112 exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: "112 derived, 112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a derived zero, every line carried its exit code). Two families first exited 3 (prerequisite) on the earlier head and were built for and re-run, not left unmeasured: `check:skill-examples` (built `@objectstack/client-react`) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (full `turbo run build`). History deepened first (`--shallow-since=2026-07-13`).
- Not run locally: `test:repo` (CI's `Test Core`); the repo-wide `pnpm lint` (CI).

## Acceptance notes

- **The runtime page save door does not run the visibility rule.** `validateVisibilityPredicates` declares `runtimeTypes: ['view']`, so `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor('page')` is `validatePresetComparands, validateComponentProps, validateComponentTypes, validatePrintPageBlocks`; a lint-level probe of those four on a page `visibleWhen` of `totallyBogusFn(1)` drew no function-existence finding. So the door this PR admits the predicate at is the CLI one (`os validate` / `os lint` / `os build`, `commands: ALL`), which is what the pin measures. Not measured through a booted HTTP save.
- `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` is not edited (it documents bare-callable catalog functions; `can` is not in it either, and `skills/**` is a Tier H surface). `hasCapability` is receiver-only, so the catalog drift pin (bare-callables) does not move.
- objectui's binding of `systemPermissions` into page predicates is the objectui card the ruling filed; until it lands, a page `visibleWhen` calling `hasCapability` faults and the component renders (fail-open, stated in the describe).
